02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.36 of 2024, pending on the file of learned Addl. District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Angul arising out of NTPC P.S. Case No. 93 of 2024 for commission of the alleged offence under Section 363/376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned A.D.J.-cum- Special Court, under POCSO At, Angul by order dated 03.07.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 26.06.2024 and as charge sheet has been filed on 23.08.2024, the Petitioner may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. Statement of the victim.
